source_policy: Use these exact commits, not the latest PR heads. All work stays on the fork; do not submit, comment on, or modify upstream or fork PRs from the qualification job.

targets.scope: Prepared raw descriptor geometry, retained covariant detector storage with corrected scale-space geometry equality, and omitted unused SVD vectors. No NMS index.
Independent bounded covariant feature suppression. No prepared geometry or retained detector changes.

required: Complete native and selected-owner sanitizer CPU suites without skipped or missing tests
Complete raw-float and ordered feature/keypoint/descriptor equality
Configured static-analysis baseline/candidate comparison, with retained warnings and failures
All predeclared timing rows, controls, runtime-provider identities and memory observations
Verified evidence archive plus actual delivery identifiers

performance_verdict.rule: Report all four paired primary differences. A positive median alone is insufficient when same-arm drift, ordinary-path changes, CPU-time behavior, or inconsistent pair signs undermine attribution. Return inconclusive rather than forcing a pass. Do not sum component savings or subtract different-cohort controls.
performance_verdict.memory: Report measured peak RSS and retained-buffer lifetime; storage reuse can increase peak memory.
